position_has_positive_upnl.meaning: the position has high enough positive uPNL that the user can withdraw initial margin via removeMargin

negative_pnl_before_liquidation.meaning: magnitude of the position's negative PnL that exists at liquidation time

bad_debt_after_liquidation.meaning: total bad debt that must be covered by the protocol insurance fund after the liquidation

assumptions: The withdrawal scenario is the position owner calling removeMargin on a position with positive uPNL, as described in the report.
The liquidation scenario is conditional and follows the margin withdrawal; the report does not establish a prior transaction showing margin was already withdrawn before liquidation.
The report does not specify whether the withdrawal fully empties margin or leaves a nonzero remainder.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric threshold for 'high enough pnl' or for the minimum margin requirement, so the positive-uPNL precondition is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric bound.

Report does not establish a prior transaction/state showing the position already had margin withdrawn before liquidation; the liquidation scenario is conditional and its trigger is not fully specified.
Report does not state the numeric magnitude of the negative PnL or the resulting bad debt; the conservation relation is expressed symbolically at the amount level.

limitations: Only the negative_pnl_becomes_bad_debt impact is formalized; the liquidation-fee and backstop-reward impacts are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
The conservation relation is stated at the amount level because the report provides no numeric values for negative PnL or bad debt.
The positive-uPNL precondition is a qualitative Boolean because the report omits numeric thresholds.
The liquidation scenario is conditional; the report does not establish that margin was already withdrawn before liquidation.
